title: Life of Captain Marvel #4 Marvel 2018 1st Full App Mari-Ell Tedesco Cover
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
The Life of Captain Marvel #4 (of 5) (Marvel, October 2018). First full appearance and origin of Mari-Ell, Carol Danvers' Kree mother. Written by Margaret Stohl, art by Carlos Pacheco, cover by Julian Totino Tedesco. First printing, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Citizen Marvel watches Spider-Man ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
